      1. Overview and Acceptance

      These Terms govern 10KEY, a game provided by Junhee Choi under the name House Duck in Germany (the “Operator”). They apply on every platform or store through which you play or obtained 10KEY (for example CrazyGames, Google Play, the Apple App Store or Steam; each a “platform”).

      Use of the game requires acceptance of these Terms. The shared House Duck Privacy Policy (section 13 describes 10KEY) is a notice explaining personal-data processing; acknowledging it is not blanket consent to that processing.

      These Terms are an agreement between you and the Operator about the game. Your use of the platform, your platform account, and any purchase, payment or ads on the platform are also governed by the platform’s own terms and privacy policy. If you obtained 10KEY from a store, that store’s terms for apps, including its licence terms, also apply.

      2. The Service

      10KEY is a single-player arcade game in which you steer a 3D numeric keypad over a board of keyboard keys. It includes:

      • The game itself, which can be played offline. Your progress (levels, upgrades and the in-game parts called “scrap”) and your settings are saved only on your device or in your browser’s storage.
      • Optional online rankings (a weekly board and an all-time board) on the Operator’s server, which need an internet connection. To send your own results, you must be signed in to your platform account where the platform offers this (today on CrazyGames).

      Whether 10KEY is offered on a particular platform, whether it is free or paid there, and which platform features (for example sign-in or ads) are available can differ between platforms.

      3. Accounts and Platforms

      • 10KEY does not require a House Duck account. On CrazyGames, 10KEY uses only your CrazyGames account; there is no House Duck account. You can play without signing in; your results are then not sent to the rankings.
      • Your platform account is provided by the platform under its own terms. The Operator cannot create, change, recover or delete it. The display name and avatar shown on the boards come from your platform account and are changed there.
      • Local saves: because your progress and settings are stored only on your device or in your browser’s storage, they may be lost if you delete the game or its data, clear your browser’s site data or play in a private window, and they are not carried over to another device or browser. The Operator holds no copy and cannot restore them. This does not limit your statutory rights.

      4. Minors

      A minor’s contractual capacity and any need for approval by a parent or other legal representative are governed by applicable law. Where legally required, that approval must be obtained for accepting these Terms, using the game and making paid purchases. The platform’s own age rules also apply. Players below the age at which they may consent to data processing on their own should play only with the permission of a parent or guardian; see section 13 of the Privacy Policy. This section does not impose additional liability on the representative or waive a minor’s statutory rights.

      5. Purchases and Refunds

      • Where 10KEY, or anything in it, is sold for a price, the purchase is made through the platform or store. It processes the payment, shows the price, taxes and payment terms, and its terms govern the purchase. The Operator receives no payment card data.
      • Refunds and withdrawal follow the store’s or platform’s refund process and mandatory consumer law; statutory rights are not limited. Requests concerning the Operator’s own obligations can be sent to support@houseduck.in.
      • A legitimate refund request or the exercise of mandatory consumer rights is not by itself grounds for a sanction.
      • In-game items and progress, including upgrades and the in-game parts called “scrap”, have no cash or real-world value and cannot be sold or exchanged for money.
      • The Operator may adjust how in-game items, upgrades and scrap are earned or used to keep the game balanced, subject to applicable law and section 11. Statutory consumer rights remain unaffected.

      6. Ads

      • Where 10KEY is free on a platform, that platform may show ads (today on CrazyGames). These ads are shown by the platform under its own terms and privacy policy, and any ad consent or ad choices are managed by the platform.
      • 10KEY itself contains no advertising SDK and no analytics SDK of its own. Data processing for the game is described in section 13 of the Privacy Policy.

      7. Online Rankings

      • The boards publicly show the rank, display name, avatar, score and level of signed-in players to anyone who views them.
      • Results are checked automatically (plausibility checks and rate limits). A result that fails these checks is flagged and may not count for the boards.
      • Weekly boards are kept for 12 weeks. Other retention periods and deletion on request are described in section 13 of the Privacy Policy.

      8. Fair Play and Prohibited Conduct

      You must not:

      • Use cheats, bots, macros or other automation tools, or modified clients, to obtain scores or ranking positions
      • Tamper with the game, its saved data or the data it sends to the server in order to obtain scores or ranking positions
      • Exploit bugs or errors to obtain scores or ranking positions
      • Send data to the server other than through the unmodified game, or attack, overload or circumvent the server, its rate limits or its checks
      • Reverse engineer, copy, or redistribute the Software (except as permitted by applicable law)
      • Violate applicable laws

      Where a violation is established, the Operator may, based on the facts and proportionately, remove or refuse records and exclude the player from the rankings. Where possible, the Operator gives reasons and an opportunity to request a review through support@houseduck.in. Exercising legal rights is not grounds for a sanction. Offline play is not affected by these measures.

      9. Intellectual Property and Licence

      Intellectual-property rights in the Software and its content belong to the Operator or relevant third-party licensors. The Operator grants you only a non-transferable, non-exclusive licence to use 10KEY for personal, non-commercial play on the platforms through which it is offered. Exceptions permitted by applicable law remain unaffected. Where a store’s licence terms apply (section 1), they also apply.

      10. Statutory Conformity and Rights

      Statutory requirements for conformity of digital products and the remedies arising from them, as well as other mandatory rights, remain unaffected. These protections take precedence also in cases of loss of locally saved progress, removal of records, exclusion from the rankings, changes to or the end of online features, and game-balance changes.

      Where applicable, you may request remedies for defective digital products, including correction, a price reduction or termination, and necessary security updates. Store refund procedures are not the only route for exercising statutory rights; requests concerning the Operator’s responsibilities may be sent to support@houseduck.in. Statutory withdrawal rights do not automatically expire merely through downloading, use, or these Terms.

      11. Availability and Changes to the Service

      • The Operator may update 10KEY. The online rankings depend on the Operator’s server and may be changed, interrupted or ended. If online features end, 10KEY remains playable without them for as long as it is available on your platform or installed on your device.
      • The online rankings are an additional feature. The Operator does not promise that they are available at all times or free of errors, that a particular result will be accepted, or a particular ranking position. Sections 10 and 12 remain unaffected.
      • Whether 10KEY stays available on a platform also depends on that platform.
      • Changes or discontinuation for updates, maintenance, or technical reasons are subject to applicable law, including the requirements of German Civil Code Section 327r where applicable. Where required, this includes valid reasons, no additional cost, clear notice, information on a durable medium, and statutory termination or refund rights for impairment.

      12. Limitation of Liability

      Liability is unrestricted for intent, gross negligence, injury to life, body, or health, and any liability that cannot be limited by law. For ordinary negligence, liability for breach of essential contractual duties may be limited, to the extent permitted by law, to foreseeable damage typical for the contract. Otherwise liability is limited to the extent permitted by law.

      13. Termination and Your Data

      • You can stop using 10KEY at any time. You can ask by email for your ranking data to be deleted; see section 13 of the Privacy Policy.
      • For serious or repeated violations of section 8, the Operator may exclude a player from the rankings permanently, after a proportionate assessment of the facts.
      • The right of both parties to terminate for good cause and all statutory rights remain unaffected.

      14. Changes to These Terms

      These Terms may be updated to reflect legal changes, changes on the platforms or service improvements. Material changes will be announced in advance on this page or in the game. Continued use alone is not automatic agreement to all changes or to optional personal-data processing. Changes requiring separate consent by law require that consent; rights under applicable law and mandatory consumer protections are not waived.

      These Terms are governed by the laws of Germany (the Operator's place of residence). Mandatory consumer protection provisions of your country of residence remain unaffected where applicable.

      If any provision of these Terms is or becomes invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions remain in effect; the statutory rules apply in place of the invalid provision.
